title: History of Earth
script:
Hook  
Picture the Earth as a lone wanderer in a swirling, star‑filled galaxy, emerging from a cosmic storm—wasn’t that the most dramatic birth story you’ve ever imagined? Old Beginnings  
Three‑billion‑plus years ago, our planet was a molten ball, a furnace of chaos and possibilities. As the shock waves of ancient meteor showers cooled into sturdy crust, the first oceans began to cradle the nascent world—a watery cradle for the future of life. Life’s Spark  
Can you hear the tiny flicker? Life burst forth, simple yet relentless, in the depths of those primordial seas. Over eons, these humble organisms wove a tapestry of complexity—cells evolved into plants, then animals, and eventually minds that could ask, “What is our place?”  

The Evolution of Earth  
Mountains rose, continents drifted, and the atmosphere sang a new song. Each era added chapters to our planet’s biography—Dinosaurs roared, glaciers carved valleys, and finally, humans looked up and stared at the stars, longing to know their home’s story.
